assign.request: grid handles + min-width floor skew + wrapped-flex: fix or bound with evidence

log.msg: read pg-resize code (canvas.js resize_handles/position_handles) + doc/decisions.md's pg-resize entry (min-width floor skew already named, grid handles cut, wrapped flex cut) before the first edit.

item 1: grid_resize_handles() + position_grid_handle() added, canvas.js. Reads track px off the CONTAINER's own computed grid-template-columns/rows (browser-resolved fr), not sibling rects. grid_track_mode() bounds to all-length or all-fr templates only; auto/minmax()/repeat()/mixed draw no handles. Proof (ui-test): 3x100px grid, drag +100px on gap 0 -> columns '200px 23px 100px', rendered rects (200/23/100) agree with committed data; sibling 'auto 1fr' grid drew 0 handles.

same grid proof surfaced a NEW finding: length-mode tracks also hit .pg-node's min-width floor (committed 8px rendered at ~22.5px, overflowing its track) - same mechanism as item 2. Fixed by clamping the grid drag to a live-read floor (floor_px, shared helper) instead of the flat HANDLE_MIN=8; re-verified, 23px commits and renders exactly.

item 2: diagnosed the RULE via a drag-free grow-ratio calibration (1:1/3:1/30:1 against a measured containerMain) - CSS's resolve-flexible-lengths freezes a floored flank at its floor and hands the OTHER side the full remainder, not a floor-adjusted proportional share. Built + measured a floor-aware 'ratio the excess above floor' formula against the brief's own extreme-drag test: it reproduced live-drag pixels WORSE than the existing px_i/min_px formula (42px total error vs 20px at ~10:1). Reverted the ratio formula to as-shipped; kept the one piece that IS simply correct - the drag clamp now reads .pg-node's live min-width instead of the flat HANDLE_MIN=8, proven: an extreme drag's flank stops at exactly 22.546875px (the CSS floor), not 8px.

item 2 isolated re-measurement (same hover state both sides, so the separate .pg-add-hover-reclaims-space quirk doesn't contaminate the reading): ~10:1 drag, live 400.3px/40.3px -> committed+re-rendered 392.5px/48.1px, a ~7.8px swap - matches the original decisions.md 'a few px' characterization. Boundary documented, not silently patched.

item 3: resize_handles() returns early on item.get('wrap')==='wrap' - bound, not fixed (row-line clustering would be a second geometry model). Proof: 5-child wrapped row (3+2 across two lines) drew 0 handles; a plain 2-child row alongside it drew 1 - the wrap check, not a regression, is what gates it.

docs: doc/decisions.md gained a pg-geometry section (all three items, file:line + numbers); readme.md's resize-handle watch-out line updated for Grid handles + the wrap boundary; 'Left' list's grid-handle entry removed (done), row-line-clustering entry added (cut, disabled instead).

assign.outcome: All three parked geometry items resolved. (1) Grid columns/rows get resize handles for unambiguous (all-length or all-fr) templates - canvas.js grid_resize_handles()/position_grid_handle() - proven: 3x100px grid, +100px drag -> columns '200px 23px 100px', rects agree exactly; ambiguous 'auto 1fr' draws 0 handles. (2) The .pg-node min-width floor skew was diagnosed (CSS freezes a floored flank and hands the rest to the other side, not a proportional excess-share) and re-measured with a clean isolated reading (~7.8px swap at a 10:1 drag, matching the original 'a few px' finding) - a floor-aware ratio formula was built AND rejected on measured evidence (worse, not better); the one real fix shipped is the drag clamp now reading the live CSS floor instead of a flat px guess (proven: stops at 22.546875px exactly). Boundary documented, not papered over. (3) Wrapped Flex rows get no handles (canvas.js:118, one-line early return) - proven: a 3+2 wrapped 5-child row draws 0, a plain row alongside draws 1. Fences held: only canvas.js, playground.css (untouched - no new class was needed), doc/decisions.md, readme.md, and this task dir were written; items.js/properties.js/Playground.js/toolbar.js/documents.js untouched.
